item.title: Bulletin updated at 20:50 HKT 04/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The upper-air disturbances will continue to bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China tomorrow. An anticyclone aloft is expected to affect the coastal areas gradually, the weather will be brighter and hot over the region in the following couple of days. An easterly airstream will reach the coast of southern China on Wednesday. There will be a few showers over the region. It will be windier over the coastal areas in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 05/05 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. More showers and a few squally thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off gradually during the day with sunny intervals.
